text:
incident-bot: Paging oncall: Routing-error alert (high p99 + 429s) for /v1/embeddings - incident_id=INC-2026-17985

emma (oncall): I’m on it. seeing a spike in p99 and some 429s coming from routing-layer to pool-dedicated-eu-2, ETA 10m to triage

chris (sre): Heads up: CI from the autoscaler test last night changed the fallback-policy weights. Could be sending more traffic to the smaller dedicated pool. I’ll check routing logs.

jordana (eng-runtime): Confirmed. router logs show a sudden change at 1798499945 where policy "prefer_dedicated" weight jumped from 20 to 75 — likely rollout.

emma (oncall): Can we put a quick override to revert weights? we need to stop queuing.

jordana (eng-runtime): Pushing rollback now: 
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/routing/override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route": "/v1/embeddings","override":{"prefer_dedicated":20}}'
```

jordana (eng-runtime): Sent. Router accepted. Watch p99.

chia (ops-bot): autoscaler: scaling dedicated-eu-2 from 4 -> 8 GPUs (requested by jordana)

emma (oncall): p99 dropping, 429s decreasing. Looks like rollback + scale helped. Status: partial mitigation.

lia (support): Any confirmed customer impact? Support queue has 3 reports from EU customers saying slower embeddings and timeouts. I filed CS-3211

mike (product): Noting this for customer comms. Which customers affected? lia, can you share list in the postmortem?

chris (sre): Root cause hypothesis: a config rollout for routing weights propagated a bad default. It should have been staged to a canary but went to global. We'll collect evidence.

emma (oncall): Action items (live):
- Emergency rollback of routing weights (completed) — jordana
- Scale up dedicated pool (inflight) — ops-bot / jordana
- Set temporary rate-limit on noisy client keys to reduce tail — emma (oncall)

emma (oncall): Temporary rate-limit applied to keys flagged in CS-3211. Monitoring.

chris (sre): Logging note: saved router state snapshot at 1798500120 and routing-policy change diff. Links: https://internal/logs/routing/1798500120 and https://internal/diffs/policy-17985

jordana (eng-runtime): Will open PR to add a stricter rollout guard to the routing service (require canary flag + approval). Drafting now.

emma (oncall): Escalating to post-incident review. Proposed time: 1798580000 (tomorrow 11:00 PT). Who can attend?

mike (product): I can. Will bring customer impact summary and affected accounts.

lia (support): Adding support tickets and sample request IDs to the incident binder.

chris (sre): I can do RCA and metrics. Also propose a code-level test that blocks weight-change without a canary tag.

jordana (eng-runtime): Assigning follow-ups in tracker:
- RTE-452: Add rollout guard and approval flow (owner: jordana)
- RTE-453: Improve router diff visibility and alert on large weight jumps (owner: chris)
- OPS-321: Autoscaler integration test to prevent unexpected policy changes (owner: ops)

emma (oncall): Adding remediation items:
- Short-term: enforce manual approval for >15% weight changes (implemented as temporary policy) — deployed by jordana — ETA 24h
- Mid-term: canary rollout + automated rollback if p99 > SLO in 5m window — design by chris+jordana — ETA 2w
- Long-term: runbook update and brown-bag training for routing rollouts (owner: emma) — schedule 3/23

ops-bot: Created issue RTE-452, link: https://tracker.internal/RTE-452

lia (support): Noted two impacted enterprise customers: Acme Retail (ticket CS-3208) and Nova Labs (CS-3211). I’ll draft CS comms postmortem.

mike (product): Recommend a short customer-facing summary for affected customers with timeline + actions. I’ll draft and share in #customer-notify for approval.

emma (oncall): Postmortem plan:
- Draft due: 1798520000 (end of day) — assigned to chris
- Review & feedback: 1798530000 — all participants
- Postmortem publish + internal brown-bag invite: 1798580000

chris (sre): I’ll include metrics: request rate by route, p50/p95/p99, 429 counts, router diff, and timeline of rollout.

jordana (eng-runtime): Quick checklist for the postmortem: evidence, chronology, root cause, blast radius, mitigation timeline, action items with owners and ETA, lessons learned.

emma (oncall): Brown-bag plan: 45m session to cover prevention patterns, routing rollout do/don’ts, runbook walkthrough, Q&A. Prefer next Thu 10:00 PT.

lia (support): Can we include support in the brown-bag so they know how to triage quickly?

mike (product): +1 include support and solutions engineering. Also add a short appendix on customer comms cadence.

emma (oncall): Great. I’ll send calendar invites after postmortem is ready.

emma (oncall): Closing notes: incident marked as mitigated at 1798501300, monitoring for regressions. Will reopen if we see new alerts.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-17985 updated to "mitigated" (mitigation time: 1798501300). Postmortem workflow started.
